run_print_token: run the script to print only the Claude Code OAuth access token from macOS Keychain
run_print_export: run the script to print a shell export command for the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN environment variable
run_write_credentials: run the script to write the full Claude Code OAuth credentials container to a specified file
run_show_target: run the script to show the resolved Keychain service and account names without reading Keychain
run_override_service_account: run the script with custom --service and --account flags to override default Keychain lookup targets
